actual: Frozen 181-day HUMAN_SIM study records zero dispatches in all six 180/300-second accounts. HumanOperationQueue.enqueue retains the original valid_until while the unique timing core continues returning current OPPORTUNITY decisions with renewed valid_until. Shared phase-1 contract section on D0/1/3/5 explicitly requires continuous same-opportunity revalidation for renewal, preserving the first delay origin; LocalSIM own dual-mode design requires current opportunity validity and no duplicate enqueue or reaction-clock reset. The adapter currently discards those native renewals, making a live opportunity unreachable solely because reaction delay exceeds first decision TTL. Fix only LocalSIM to consume causally verified contiguous renewals without changing core rules, 90-second TTL, human capacity, old research pins, original outcomes or the 288 cases. Renewals must never revive expired/withdrawn/revised/previously dispatched actions or cross a plan hard deadline.
